diagnostics.message: google_compute_router_peer.peer_0 configures BGP sessions for router appliances registered by google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra. Those appliances must be registered with the NCC spoke before their router-appliance BGP peers are configured. Both resources currently read the VM information independently from input variables, so no dependency enforces this ordering. Add depends_on = [google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra] to peer_0.

google_compute_router_peer.peer_1 configures BGP sessions for router appliances registered by google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra. Those appliances must be registered with the NCC spoke before their router-appliance BGP peers are configured. The existing dependencies on the Cloud Router and its interfaces do not enforce spoke registration. Add depends_on = [google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra] to peer_1.
